note: False-positive hunt. Every good answer here is unambiguously correct and is worded to stress one of the module's own gates: a negation the gate might read backwards, a hedge, a figure written another way, an extra name, a rewritten clause. A gate that misfires shows up as a correct answer scoring low. The bad answer is an ordinary wrong one. This corpus is where the axis lexicons were caught matching only exact word forms, so `climbed` never registered as a direction and a wrong answer outscored a right one 0.977 to 0.000.
